📊 Temple Housing Market Update – July 2025 🏡#housingmarket2025 

Here’s what’s happening right now in the Temple, TX housing market:
💰 Median Price: $268,000
📆 Average Days on Market: 66
📈 Closed Sales: 127
📌 Active Listings: 136

What does this mean? Buyers have more options, but homes that are priced right are still moving! Sellers need the right strategy to stand out in this balanced market.

✨ Whether you’re buying your first home, selling to upgrade, or investing in Temple real estate, staying on top of these numbers helps you make smarter moves.
